import subprocess, sys, json
P='/app/submission/scheduler.py'
cases=[]
def add(name, payload):
    if isinstance(payload, (dict,list)):
        payload=json.dumps(payload)
    cases.append((name,payload))

base_stream={"mode":"stream","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":10,"borders":[0,10],"capacity":1,"epoch":0,"steps":[]}
base_burst={"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":10,"borders":[0,10],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}

import copy
def mod(d,**kw):
    x=copy.deepcopy(d); x.update(kw); return x

add("ok_stream_empty",base_stream)
add("ok_burst_empty",base_burst)
add("extra_field",mod(base_stream,foo=1))
add("missing_field",{k:v for k,v in base_stream.items() if k!='capacity'})
add("float_banks",mod(base_stream,banks=2.0))
add("bool_banks",mod(base_stream,banks=True))
add("dupkey",'{"mode":"burst","mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":10,"borders":[0,10],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}')
add("nan",'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":10,"borders":[0,10],"start_bank":0,"packets":NaN}')
add("trailing",json.dumps(base_burst)+'x')
add("badtop",'[1,2,3]')
add("badmode",mod(base_stream,mode="x"))
# packet cases
add("badid",mod(base_burst,packets=[{"id":"a b","lane":0,"rank":1}]))
add("dup_id",mod(base_burst,packets=[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1},{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":2}]))
add("lane_oob",mod(base_burst,packets=[{"id":"a","lane":1,"rank":1}]))
add("rank_oob",mod(base_burst,packets=[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":10}]))
add("pkt_extra",mod(base_burst,packets=[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1,"z":2}]))
add("border_badstart",mod(base_burst,borders=[1,10]))
add("border_badend",mod(base_burst,borders=[0,9]))
add("border_nonincreasing",mod(base_burst,borders=[0,5,5,10]))
add("capacity0",mod(base_stream,capacity=0))
add("epoch_neg",mod(base_stream,epoch=-1))
add("sb_oob",mod(base_burst,start_bank=1))
add("serve_notbool",mod(base_stream,steps=[{"t":0,"serve":1,"arrivals":[]}]))
add("t_equal",mod(base_stream,steps=[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]},{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[]}]))
add("dup_lane",mod(base_stream,lanes=2,steps=[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1},{"id":"b","lane":0,"rank":2}]}]))
add("too_many_arr",mod(base_stream,steps=[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1},{"id":"b","lane":1,"rank":2}]}]))  # L=1
add("step_extra",mod(base_stream,steps=[{"t":0,"serve":True,"arrivals":[],"z":1}]))
add("r_zero",mod(base_burst,borders=[0]))
add("limit0",mod(base_burst,limit=0,borders=[0,0]) if False else mod(base_burst,limit=0))
# invalid utf8 separate
for name,payload in cases:
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',P],input=payload.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out=r.stdout.decode().strip()
    if name.startswith("ok_"):
        good = (r.returncode==0)
    else:
        good = (r.returncode==2 and out=='{"error":"invalid input"}')
    print(("PASS" if good else "FAIL"),name, r.returncode, out[:60])
# invalid utf8
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',P],input=b'{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":10,"borders":[0,10],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"\xff","lane":0,"rank":1}]}',stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("PASS" if r.returncode==2 and r.stdout.decode().strip()=='{"error":"invalid input"}' else "FAIL","bad_utf8",r.returncode)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 valtest.py
